patches.name: Alerts bar in Android Auto
patches.description: Shows a vertical bar on the right of the Android Auto map with the reports on your route in the next 10 km: speed cameras, police, accidents, jams, hazards and closures. In a section control zone it also shows your average speed, the speed limit and the distance left.

patches.name: Favorites on map
patches.description: Always shows your favorites as stars with their name on the map, on the phone and in Android Auto, also when not navigating.
